description: This file contains unit tests for the ControlBackend component, specifically testing its interaction with the Control and ControlMock classes, including control creation, registration, application state handling, and cleanup.

classes.name: ControlBackendTests
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing ControlBackend behavior with mock dependencies.

methods.name: ShouldFailToStartWhenControlIsNull
methods.description: Tests that ControlBackend fails to start when control creation returns null.

methods.name: ShouldFailToStartWhenRegisterClientFails
methods.description: Tests that ControlBackend fails to start when registering the control client fails.

methods.name: ShouldSkipWaitingForRunningWhenRunningStateWasSetDuringInitialisation
methods.description: Verifies that waitForRunning returns true if the application state was set to RUNNING during registration.

methods.name: ShouldSkipWaitingForRunningWhenRunningStateWasSetEarlier
methods.description: Verifies that waitForRunning returns true if the application state was set to RUNNING before calling waitForRunning.

methods.name: ShouldFailToWaitForRunning
methods.description: Tests that waitForRunning returns false if the application state remains INACTIVE.

methods.name: ShouldRemoveControlBackend
methods.description: Tests that removeControlBackend properly cleans up the ControlBackend instance.
